vuln.name: Chinese Address / Location Disclosed
vuln.description: A response body contains detailed address or location information (Chinese province/city/district and street-level address patterns).
vuln.impact: Disclosure of detailed addresses is a privacy breach under PIPL and may enable physical attacks or doxxing.
vuln.recommendation: Remove detailed address fields from responses shown to untrusted users. Store only what is needed and mask sensitive portions.
